notes.title: 2/4 Update: SteamInput for Windows & Mac versions
notes.notes:
We've updated the Mac & Windows versions of Moon to use SteamInput, which will allow you to automatically use a controller with the game!

If your controller isn't automatically recognized, please refer to the link that corresponds to the controller you are using:

PS4 Controllers (DualShock 4) 
[url=steam://controllerconfig/1714580/2738724295]steam://controllerconfig/1714580/2738724295[/url]

Xbox One Controllers
[url=steam://controllerconfig/1714580/2738932238]steam://controllerconfig/1714580/2738932238[/url]

Nintendo Switch Pro Controllers
[url=steam://controllerconfig/1714580/2739850974]steam://controllerconfig/1714580/2739850974[/url]

If you experience any issues after the update, please let us know via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1714580/discussions/1/]forum[/url].

notes.title: 12/27 Update: Controller support!
notes.notes:
We just updated the game with the following changes:
[list]
[*] Added controller support
Tested with PS4, Xbox One & Xbox 360 controllers
[*] Fixed some help text
The descriptions for Menu and Item Bar were mixed up, but they're not anymore!
[/list]

If you experience any issues after the update, please let us know via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1714580/discussions/1/]forum[/url].
